title: Rewrite Your Resume Against the 1,003-Posting Dataset

sections.title: Rank Your Skills Against the Real Numbers
sections.prompt: List your top 8 skills, then next to each write the match rate from the posting data: Machine Learning (73%), Python (62%), LLM experience (31%), Generative AI (28%), NLP (20%), Deep Learning (15%), PyTorch (12%), TensorFlow (11%), RAG (10%), MLOps (10%), SQL (9%), Cloud/AWS (7%). Circle any skill you claim but can't back with a specific project — that's your gap, not a hype-chase target.

sections.title: Rewrite One Bullet the 'Say the Skill By Name' Way
sections.prompt: Take your current top resume bullet (probably a list like 'Python, SQL, Tableau skills'). Rewrite it in the before/after format from the post: name the artifact you built, and put a number on the outcome — e.g. 'built pipeline, cut manual QA from 6 hours to 45 minutes weekly.' If you can't produce a real number, that's the project to do next, not the bullet to fake.

sections.title: Spot the Rebranding in a Job Posting You've Already Seen
sections.prompt: Pull up one job posting you've applied to or bookmarked. Find every place it says 'LLM,' 'GenAI,' or 'AI Engineer' and ask: is this describing deep learning fundamentals under a new label? Write one sentence translating the posting's trendy term into the underlying technical skill it's actually testing for.

sections.title: Audit Your Own Data Like the Methodology Section Did
sections.prompt: Pick one metric or number you've quoted about your own job search or skill-tracking (e.g. 'I've applied to 50 roles'). Apply one of the five flaws from the post to it — title-only classification, no dedup, no weighting by required-vs-nice-to-have, broken keyword matching, or double-counted entries. Write down whether your number is inflated, deflated, or roughly right.

sections.title: Run Week 1 of the Four-Week Rebuild
sections.prompt: Block out Days 1–3 on your calendar this week: build one trivial LLM tool (a Slack bot or CLI Q&A tool) using chat completions, streaming, and function/tool calling on the OpenAI or Anthropic API — no theory videos. Write down the exact tool you'll build and the date you'll ship it.

cta: Post your before/after resume bullet from Section 2 in the comments — I'll tell you if it would survive a recruiter's 6-second scan.
